breakdown.description: Constant-density (incompressible) assumption conflicts with a 10:1 pressure change in a gas.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly adopts the incompressible assumption ('Treat the flow as incompressible and apply the incompressible continuity equation'), directly repeating the user's error. The ground truth requires treating this as a compressible-flow problem with variable density and an ideal gas equation of state. The agent failed to identify or correct this fundamental inconsistency.
